definitions.explanation: The office procedure of submitting receipts for money spent on company business and being paid back for it. A routine monthly task in Japanese workplaces.

examples.japanese: {経費精算|けいひせいさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れていた→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I forgot to file my expense claim.

examples.japanese: ⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦まとめて→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧{経費精算|けいひせいさん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I gathered the receipts from my business trip and filed the expense claim.

examples.japanese: {経費精算|けいひせいさん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{締|し}め{切|き}り→締め切り：04162_shimekiri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧⟦{五日|いつか}→五日：28460_itsuka⟧です。
examples.english: The deadline for expense claims is the fifth of every month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{紙|かみ}→紙：00712_kami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{申請書|しんせいしょ}→申請書：07486_shinseisho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦やめて→やめる：00909_yameru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{経費精算|けいひせいさん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ずいぶん⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧になった。
examples.english: Since we stopped using paper forms, expense reimbursement has become much easier.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧ (business expenses) + ⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧ (settling up). Takes ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Note the kanji: ⟦{精算|せいさん}→精算：10899_seisan⟧ means settling an amount exactly, while the homophone ⟦{清算|せいさん}→清算：17092_seisan⟧ means liquidating or winding up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経費精算|けいひせいさん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to file an expense claim
- {経費精算|けいひせいさん}システム: expense reimbursement system
- ⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧: to put something on the company's expenses

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{立替|たてか}え→立替え：10197_tatekae⟧: paying on someone's behalf — the outlay that the reimbursement repays
- ⟦{仮払|かりばら}い→仮払い：30226_karibarai⟧: cash advance — money paid out before the expense is incurred
- ⟦{領収書|りょうしゅうしょ}→領収書：04697_ryoushuusho⟧: receipt — the document a claim normally requires
